entries.1b05dfe8158c8e32: The 24 Medium-Term Management Plan (fiscal 2024–2026) sets out three basic policies: "sales of 800,000 tons of steel products," "decarbonization response" and "development of a sustainable foundation." Through efficient operation that brings out the performance of the new electric furnace, cost reduction, lower environmental impact and further quality improvement, and by stably supplying high-quality products to the market, it aims to sustainably enhance corporate value.
